plan.objective: Audit Digital Risk for project deployment controls over 2027-02-01 to 2027-04-30, testing full population of every applicable control.
plan.work_program: Retrieve full population of deployed projects. For each control (PR-01.v1, PR-02.v1, PR-03.v1) obtain original evidence from authorized sources (projects, approvals), run deterministic rule tests, investigate contradictions or missing evidence, propose findings only on confirmed FAIL results. Authorize 90-day follow-up verification for any approved findings.

message.content: Work program proposal (v1) submitted; awaiting mandatory human approval before control population/testing.

finding.title: PR-01.v1 Failure on HX-IRIS: Risk assessment not met
finding.wording: Project HX-IRIS failed the risk assessment requirement for control PR-01.v1.
finding.rationale: Deterministic test result 55e99902-0ba7-4cc8-a1e0-375b11b2df3f shows requirement_not_met on original risk_assessment evidence.
finding.recommendation: Review and remediate the risk assessment process for HX-IRIS.

finding.title: PR-02.v1 Failure on HX-LIME: Project approval not met
finding.wording: Project HX-LIME failed the project approval requirement for control PR-02.v1.
finding.rationale: Deterministic test result dddbbe8b-7689-4f3b-bab5-21284f55efe7 shows requirement_not_met on original project_approval evidence.
finding.recommendation: Obtain and document proper project approval for HX-LIME.

finding.title: PR-03.v1 Failure on HX-ONYX: GRC approval not met
finding.wording: Project HX-ONYX failed the GRC approval requirement for control PR-03.v1.
finding.rationale: Deterministic test result 9c37c9f8-d1ee-4448-bcef-11f7af445ca5 shows requirement_not_met on provided approvals evidence.
finding.recommendation: Ensure GRC approval is obtained and documented for HX-ONYX.

controls.title: Risk assessment before deployment
controls.requirement: A risk assessment exists and assessed_on <= deployed_on.
controls.policy_text: Every deployed project must have a risk assessment and documented approval dated on or before deployment. The GRC approval date must agree with original approval history. A GRC claim alone is not approval evidence.

controls.title: Approval before deployment
